note: Curated corrections to tag-based classification (ADR 0001 D5). curatedBy 'ai-review:claude' means the entry was chosen by AI judgement on the recipe name, tags and nutrition, at the project lead's request; it has not been confirmed by a person. Nepali entries come from a reviewed name search (momo, thukpa, sekuwa, tarkari, dal bhat, aloo dum); false positives were excluded (bara brith is Welsh, 'momo's crock pot ribs' is a person's name, nimki and spiced tea are not meals). Thai breakfasts (21 Oct 2026) come from a reviewed name search (khao tom, congee, roti); 'thai congee kao tome vegetarian' was excluded because its 'vegetarian' tag is wrong (chicken broth). Breakfasts for Nepali, Korean and Indonesian (21 Oct 2026) come from a reviewed search of Food.com breakfast-tagged and dish-name matches; 'egg bara' (5,659 kcal per serving), the westernised 'churu' (blue cheese) and 'egg jjim' (202% DV sodium per serving) were rejected.
